candidate.user_input: Compare permitted cabin upgrades for domestic versus international flights, including conditions for the international business-class exception. Preserve continuous-flight duration and trip-purpose qualifiers.
candidate.reference: Domestic flights over 5 hours consecutive flight time allow booking the next class up from standard economy below business class. International flights over 5 hours consecutive flight time allow the same upgrade. For international flights exceeding 8 hours consecutive flight time, frequent travelers (3+ trips per quarter, minimum 6 segments) may book business class when traveling for customer meetings, speaking engagements, or representing GitLab at conferences.

evidence.quote: For domestic flights with a duration greater than 5 hours of consecutive flight time (each segment must be 5+ hours), team members are authorized to book the next class up from standard economy as long as it is below business class.
evidence.contribution: Defines domestic flight upgrade policy for flights over 5 hours consecutive flight time.

evidence.quote:
For international flights with a duration greater than 5 hours of consecutive flight time (each segment must be 5+ hours), team members are authorized to book the next class up from standard economy as long as it is below business class.

For those who travel frequently, defined as 3 or more trips per quarter internationally on flights of 8 hrs+ continuous flight time (minimum 6 flight segments with 8+ hours per segment), business class is permitted when traveling for any of the following reasons:
  - Meeting with customers
  - Speaking engagement
  - Representing GitLab at a conference
evidence.contribution: Defines international flight upgrade policy for flights over 5 hours and business class exception for frequent travelers on flights over 8 hours with specific trip purposes.

candidate.connection: Context 0 defines domestic flight upgrade rules; Context 1 defines international flight upgrade rules and business class exceptions for frequent travelers with specific trip purposes.

source_conditions: Domestic flights: duration greater than 5 hours of consecutive flight time (each segment must be 5+ hours) allows booking next class up from standard economy, but below business class.
International flights: duration greater than 5 hours of consecutive flight time (each segment must be 5+ hours) allows booking next class up from standard economy, but below business class.

International flights: business class permitted for flights exceeding 8 hours of consecutive flight time, for frequent travelers (3+ trips per quarter internationally on flights of 8+ hours, minimum 6 flight segments with 8+ hours per segment), and only when traveling for customer meetings, speaking engagements, or representing GitLab at a conference.
